source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of unit testing (PDF 27).

blocks.text: Unit Testing testing ka pehla level hai, jis mein software ke alag alag components ya modules ko akela (in isolation) test kiya jata hai. Har "unit" software ka chhota sa hissa hai jise test kiya ja sake, jaise koi function ya method. Unit testing ka asal maqsad yeh confirm (pakka) karna hai ke har component apne design ke mutabiq theek kaam kare aur umeed ke mutabiq chale.
Apni pasandeeda programming language mein kisi saade function ka unit test likhne ki koshish karein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal ke taur par Python mein add() function ka ek saada unit test aisa ho sakta hai. assert check karta hai ke nateeja sahi hai; agar koi nateeja ghalat ho to program AssertionError de kar ruk jata hai.

def add(a, b):
    return a + b


def test_add():
    assert add(2, 3) == 5
    assert add(-1, 1) == 0
    assert add(0, 0) == 0
    print("Sab tests pass ho gaye")


test_add()
blocks.caption: add() function ka unit test

blocks.prompt: add(a, b) function jo do numbers ka jama deta hai, us ka unit test kya check karega?
blocks.explanation: Function ko akela, maloom inputs ke saath chala kar nateeja sahi jawab se milaya jata hai: add(2, 3) ka 5, add(-1, 1) ka 0 aur add(0, 0) ka 0 aana chahiye. Agar koi nateeja mukhtalif aaye to us unit mein bug hai.

items: Unit testing: pehla level; har chhota unit (function ya method) akela test hota hai.
